ten_stage_pipeline_conceptual.description: Industrial-scale execution framework. Soul DNA Bible defines WHAT and WHY. Nuclear Harvest defines HOW — at scale with verification.

stages.name: RAW HARVEST
stages.action: Mine all source material — chat logs, documents, voice notes, decisions. Zero pre-filtering.

stages.name: DNA EXTRACTION
stages.action: Apply CRUNCHER protocol. Extract mandates, constraints, metrics, triggers, identity claims. Tag with source/line/context.
stages.output: Tagged DNA fragments with full provenance.

stages.name: LINELOCK
stages.action: Progressive hardening V1→V8. Line-level locking. Hash verification at every version boundary.

stages.name: AGENT ASSEMBLY
stages.action: Build Triad: Agent 100 (Sovereign), Agent 99 (Orchestrator), Agent 98 (Builder). Lock roles. Inject Soul DNA hash.
stages.output: Functional agent hierarchy with sealed roles.

stages.name: NUCLEAR HARVEST CORE (DEATHSTAR)
stages.action: Takes linelocked Bible + assembled agents → execution layer. 6-AI Jury, consensus engine, drift detection, pheromone routing.

stages.name: 99-AGENT SWARM
stages.action: Scale Triad to full swarm. Deploy extraction/verification/deployment/monitoring drones.

stages.name: PHEROMONE LATTICE
stages.action: Connect agents via pheromone trails. Successful paths strengthen, failed paths evaporate. Self-organizing.

stages.name: GOVERNANCE PHYSICS (SHIT TEST OS)
stages.action: Apply TMST at every level. Every agent/drone/output must prove value within 10 minutes.

stages.name: AUDIT AND SEAL
stages.action: Full forensic audit by Agent 97. Drift → Nuke Protocol. Integrity failure → full revert.

stages.name: DEPLOYMENT AND REINCARNATION
stages.action: Deploy to production. Monitor. Chaos → Reincarnation Protocol: snapshot → die → reborn with new knowledge.
stages.output: Live system with built-in Phoenix Protocol.
